verdict.rationale: Orb publishes a full OpenAPI 3.1 document on its docs domain, lists it under "OpenAPI Specs" in llms.txt, and offers an unauthenticated canonical download at api.withorb.com/spec.json, with a ?version=3.0 option for OpenAPI 3.0 compatibility. The probe's 404s were on guessed generic paths, not the documented URLs, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on probe confirming that the documented spec URLs actually serve the document.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Orb publishes its full OpenAPI 3.1 document on the docs domain (listed under "## OpenAPI Specs" in the docs llms.txt)
You can download the latest OpenAPI spec [here](https://api.withorb.com/spec.json) - pass `?version=3.0` for an OpenAPI 3.0-compatible spec
